items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: It's the higher shield, Lester Nelson, me, with the spanzer.

ctx.x: Well, you know a couple of them. Yeah. Well, here's Harry Shields. On the right. Playing out of time. Oh.

Tenor. Tenor. Looks like he's got a clarinet too, huh? Right. Mr. Pettit, to get a megaphone, cut the hose out and put on a megaphone, you know, clarinet together. It's the higher shield, Lester Nelson, me, with the spanzer. That's a big bass drum, 28 inches.
You say you had a 30 inch at one time, with a track though. That's right. But you weren't as good as Willie Guitart. No, I didn't steal the thing.
